title: Hepatocellular Carcinoma in 2021: An Exhaustive Update

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Hepatocellular Carcinoma in 2021: An Exhaustive Update》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-10】The current review is aimed at providing exhaustive updates on the etiology, molecular biology, biomarker diagnosis, imaging, and recommended treatment options in patients with HCC.

evidence.text: The current review is aimed at providing exhaustive updates on the etiology, molecular biology, biomarker diagnosis, imaging, and recommended treatment options in patients with HCC.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Hepatocellular Carcinoma in 2021: An Exhaustive Update》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】Novel tools for the surveillance and diagnosis of HCC include protein-, genomics-, and composite algorithm-based clinical/biomarker panels.

【Abstract · abstract-1-8】A select group of patients still benefit from modified surgical and early interventional radiology treatments.

evidence.text: Novel tools for the surveillance and diagnosis of HCC include protein-, genomics-, and composite algorithm-based clinical/biomarker panels.
A select group of patients still benefit from modified surgical and early interventional radiology treatments.
